text.en: You've been running like a browser with 80 tabs open, and the fan is screaming. Everything still works, technically, but you can feel the whole system getting warm.
text.zh: 你最近像开了 80 个标签页的浏览器，风扇嗡嗡狂转。东西勉强还能跑，但你能感觉到整个系统都在发烫。

text.en: Close some tabs and breathe
text.zh: 关掉几个标签页，喘口气

resultText.en: You cut your to-do list in half and go to bed early. Tomorrow-you sends a thank-you note.
resultText.zh: 你把待办清单砍掉一半，早早睡了。明天的你给今天的你发来感谢信。

text.en: Push through, sleep is for graduates
text.zh: 硬撑，等毕业再睡

resultText.en: You squeeze out a few more hours of studying. The notes blur together and your patience does too.
resultText.zh: 你又硬挤出几个小时复习。笔记糊成一团，耐心也一起糊了。

text.en: Take a short walk outside
text.zh: 出门走一小圈

resultText.en: Fresh air, no agenda. Your brain quietly reboots and the fan stops screaming.
resultText.zh: 新鲜空气，没有任务。脑子悄悄重启，风扇终于不叫了。

text.en: It's 2 a.m. and your brain is hosting an unscheduled review session on every embarrassing thing you've ever done. The ceiling has no answers, but you keep checking.
text.zh: 凌晨两点，你的大脑临时召开了一场复盘大会，主题是你这辈子所有的尴尬时刻。天花板给不出答案，你却一直盯着它看。

text.en: Phone down, boring podcast on
text.zh: 放下手机，听个无聊播客

resultText.en: You stop scrolling and let a dull voice talk about soil for ten minutes. You're out before it gets to clay.
resultText.zh: 你不刷手机了，听一个无聊的声音讲了十分钟土壤。还没讲到黏土你就睡着了。

text.en: Might as well study then
text.zh: 睡不着不如复习

resultText.en: You learn three facts and lose two hours of sleep. Math says this was a bad trade.
resultText.zh: 你学到了三个知识点，损失了两小时睡眠。算下来这笔买卖很亏。

text.en: Warm drink, lights low
text.zh: 热饮一杯，把灯调暗

resultText.en: Something warm, no screens, low light. The 2 a.m. review session is adjourned without a vote.
resultText.zh: 来点热的，不看屏幕，灯光放暗。凌晨的复盘大会无人表决，自动散会。

text.en: Text {partner} you can't sleep
text.zh: 给{partner}发消息说睡不着

resultText.en: {partner} replies with a single sleepy thumbs-up and a typo'd 'goodnihgt'. Somehow it helps.
resultText.zh: {partner}回了个睡眼惺忪的赞，还把'晚安'打成了'晚安安'。莫名其妙地，你就安心了。

text.en: A small voice insists everyone else got into dental school on merit and you got in by clerical error. The voice is very confident for someone with no evidence.
text.zh: 脑子里有个小声音坚称，别人考上牙学院靠的是实力，而你纯属系统出 bug 录错了。这声音明明没证据，却特别自信。

text.en: List things you actually got right
text.zh: 列一列你真做对的事

resultText.en: You write down three things you nailed this week. Turns out the clerical-error theory has holes.
resultText.zh: 你写下本周做成的三件事。结果发现'系统录错'这个理论漏洞百出。

text.en: Reread your worst exam to confirm
text.zh: 重看最烂的那次考卷确认一下

resultText.en: You go looking for proof you're a fraud and, shockingly, find some. The voice high-fives itself.
resultText.zh: 你专门去找自己是冒牌货的证据，居然真找到了。那个小声音得意地给自己鼓掌。

text.en: Tell a classmate the secret thought
text.zh: 把这个秘密想法告诉同学

resultText.en: Your classmate whispers 'wait, you too?!' Turns out the whole cohort is in the Fraud Squad.
resultText.zh: 同学小声说'啊你也是？！'原来整个年级都是冒牌者协会会员。

text.en: Everyone online is publishing papers, prepping flawless crowns, and apparently sleeping eight hours. You are eating cereal over the sink, comparing your blooper reel to their highlight reel.
text.zh: 网上每个人都在发论文、做完美牙冠，还顺便睡满八小时。而你站在水池边吃麦片，拿自己的 NG 花絮去比别人的高光集锦。

text.en: Log off, run your own race
text.zh: 下线，跑自己的赛道

resultText.en: You close the app and finish your cereal in peace. Your race has exactly one runner and that's the point.
resultText.zh: 你关掉 app，安安静静吃完麦片。你的赛道只有一个选手，这正是重点。

text.en: Try to match all of them at once
text.zh: 试图一口气追平所有人

resultText.en: You start five new ambitious projects at midnight. By 1 a.m. you've finished zero and feel worse.
resultText.zh: 你半夜雄心勃勃地同时开了五个新项目。到凌晨一点，一个没完成，心情更差了。

text.en: Pick one tiny real goal for tomorrow
text.zh: 给明天定一个超小的真目标

resultText.en: You write down one doable thing for tomorrow. Small, specific, suspiciously mature, surprisingly effective.
resultText.zh: 你给明天写下一件做得到的小事。又小又具体，意外地成熟，效果好得出奇。

text.en: You realize your last real meal was a granola bar at an hour you'd rather not name. Your stomach files a formal complaint mid-lecture.
text.zh: 你猛然想起，上一顿正经饭是一根能量棒，吃的时间点你都不好意思说。讲座讲到一半，你的胃正式提交了投诉。

text.en: Go eat an actual meal
text.zh: 去吃一顿正经饭

resultText.en: Warm food, sitting down, no notes. Your brain comes back online with a friendly ping.
resultText.zh: 热乎的饭，坐下来吃，不看笔记。脑子'叮'一声友好地重新上线了。

text.en: Just get another coffee
text.zh: 再来一杯咖啡顶着

resultText.en: Cup number four arrives. You're now vibrating at a frequency only dogs can study with.
resultText.zh: 第四杯咖啡到位。你现在以一种只有狗能跟着复习的频率在抖。

text.en: Split snacks with a study buddy
text.zh: 和学伴分享点零食

resultText.en: You trade half a sandwich for half of theirs and a much-needed laugh. Calories and friendship, restored.
resultText.zh: 你用半个三明治换了对方半个，外加一阵急需的大笑。热量和友谊，双双回血。

text.en: The exam is tomorrow and your heart is auditioning for a drum solo. You know the material; your nervous system did not get the memo.
text.zh: 明天就考试了，你的心脏正在试镜一段架子鼓 solo。知识你都会了，可你的神经系统没收到这条通知。

text.en: Do a slow breathing round, then sleep
text.zh: 做几轮慢呼吸，然后睡觉

resultText.en: Four slow breaths, lights off. The drum solo fades to a calm steady beat. The tooth can wait; your nervous system cannot.
resultText.zh: 四次缓慢呼吸，关灯。架子鼓 solo 渐渐变成平稳的心跳。牙可以等，你的神经系统不能等。

text.en: Cram the whole syllabus one more time
text.zh: 把整本大纲再啃一遍

resultText.en: You re-read everything at panic speed and absorb almost none of it. Now you're tired AND jittery.
resultText.zh: 你以恐慌的速度把所有东西又过了一遍，几乎啥也没进脑子。现在你又累又抖。

text.en: Skim your one-page cheat-summary
text.zh: 扫一遍自己的一页纸总结

resultText.en: You glance over the highlights you already made, nod, and call it. Confident enough, rested enough.
resultText.zh: 你扫一眼自己早就划好的重点，点点头，收工。自信够了，休息也够了。

text.en: Let {partner} quiz you for ten minutes
text.zh: 让{partner}考你十分钟

resultText.en: {partner} reads questions in a dramatic game-show voice and gets every dental term hilariously wrong. You laugh, you remember, you relax.
resultText.zh: {partner}用夸张的综艺主持人语气念题，每个牙科术语都念得离谱搞笑。你笑了，记住了，也放松了。

text.en: You wake up and the tank reads empty. Not lazy-empty, actually-empty. Your body is gently filing for one day of mercy.
text.zh: 你一觉醒来，发现油箱见底了。不是偷懒的那种空，是真的空。你的身体正温柔地申请放它一天假。

text.en: Take the recovery day, guilt-free
text.zh: 心安理得地休一天

resultText.en: You rest on purpose, not by accident. By evening the tank reads a hopeful quarter-full.
resultText.zh: 你是有意休息，不是不小心垮掉。到傍晚，油箱回到了充满希望的四分之一格。

text.en: Force a full study day anyway
text.zh: 还是逼自己学满一整天

resultText.en: You drag yourself through the day at 20% efficiency and end up needing two recovery days instead.
resultText.zh: 你拖着自己以 20% 的效率熬过一天，结果反而欠下了两天的恢复假。

text.en: Do one easy task, then truly stop
text.zh: 做一件轻松小事，然后彻底收工

resultText.en: You handle one gentle thing, feel a little accomplished, then close the laptop for real. Balanced and humane.
resultText.zh: 你搞定一件不费劲的小事，有点成就感，然后真的合上电脑。既平衡又人道。

title.en: Talking to Someone Who Gets It

text.en: There's a counselor on campus who has heard 'I'm fine' said in that exact tired voice a thousand times. A friend nudges you to actually book the appointment.
text.zh: 校园里有位辅导员，听过一千遍用那种疲惫语气说出的'我没事'。一个朋友轻轻推了你一把，让你真的去预约。

text.en: Book it and actually go
text.zh: 预约，并且真的去

resultText.en: You say the quiet stuff out loud to someone trained to listen. Nothing magic, just lighter shoulders walking out.
resultText.zh: 你把憋在心里的话，对一个受过训练的倾听者说了出来。没什么魔法，只是走出门时肩膀轻了不少。

text.en: Tell yourself you'll go 'later'
text.zh: 告诉自己'以后'再去

resultText.en: You file it under Later, the folder where good intentions go to nap. The feeling stays put.
resultText.zh: 你把它归进'以后再说'文件夹——那是好意去打盹的地方。那股情绪原地没动。

text.en: Talk to a trusted friend first
text.zh: 先找个信得过的朋友聊聊

resultText.en: A long honest chat with a friend over bad cafeteria tea. Less clinical, still real, genuinely helps.
resultText.zh: 和朋友就着难喝的食堂奶茶聊了好久，全是真心话。没那么专业，但很真实，确实管用。

text.en: One bad lab session has somehow become 'I will never be a good dentist and also probably bad at everything.' The catastrophe machine is running overtime again.
text.zh: 一次失手的 sim lab，不知怎么就升级成了'我永远当不好牙医，而且大概干啥都不行'。灾难放大机又在加班了。

text.en: Ask: will this matter in a year?
text.zh: 问自己：一年后这还重要吗？

resultText.en: You zoom out. One wobbly afternoon does not define a career. The catastrophe machine powers down.
resultText.zh: 你把镜头拉远。一个手抖的下午，定义不了一整个职业生涯。灾难放大机自动关机。

text.en: Replay the mistake on loop
text.zh: 把失误循环播放

resultText.en: You watch the highlight (lowlight?) reel forty times. Spoiler: it does not improve with rewatching.
resultText.zh: 你把那段'高光'(低谷？)集锦看了四十遍。剧透：重看四十遍也不会变好。

text.en: Count how many things went fine today
text.zh: 数数今天有多少事是顺的

resultText.en: You tally the day honestly: one rough lab, eleven ordinary fine things. The ratio is reassuring.
resultText.zh: 你诚实地把一天盘了盘：一次手抖的 lab，十一件普普通通搞定的事。这个比例还挺安慰人。

text.en: Your body has stopped asking nicely. This is the part of the story where you take a real recovery week, and no, you don't have to earn it first.
text.zh: 你的身体已经不再客气地请求了。故事走到了这一段：你要真正休一个恢复周——不用，你不需要先'配得上'它。

text.en: Accept the recovery week fully
text.zh: 踏踏实实接受这个恢复周

resultText.en: You sleep, eat, walk, and let the textbooks gather a little honest dust. You come back actually able to think again.
resultText.zh: 你睡觉、吃饭、散步，让课本踏踏实实落点灰。回来时，你真的又能好好思考了。

text.en: Sneak in 'just a little' studying
text.zh: 偷偷'就学一点点'

resultText.en: Your 'little' study session quietly eats the whole week. The rest you needed remains theoretical.
resultText.zh: 你那'一点点'复习悄悄吞掉了整整一周。你真正需要的休息，依然停留在理论层面。

text.en: Rest mostly, plan softly for next week
text.zh: 主要休息，顺手轻轻规划下周

resultText.en: You rest for real and spend twenty calm minutes sketching next week. Recovered and quietly ready.
resultText.zh: 你真正休息，再花二十分钟平静地勾画下周的安排。既恢复了，又悄悄做好了准备。
